name: singlet_covariate_adjustment_technical_covariate_regression
title: Technical covariate regression of expression
description: Removes measured per-cell covariates such as total counts, detected genes or percent mitochondrial counts from expression and writes a residualized layer. The default pearson_analytic method removes depth through an analytic null model and takes no covariates; use nb_glm_residual or ols_log with an explicit covariates list for non-depth covariates. Not for batch or donor effects, which need batch covariate removal, and check covariate variance attribution before removing biology-linked covariates.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Residualization path. pearson_analytic removes depth only; nb_glm_residual and ols_log accept covariates.

covariates.description: obs columns to remove. Must be empty for pearson_analytic. Collinear covariates are flagged.

protect.description: obs columns kept in the joint fit so only the nuisance component is subtracted. Not used by pearson_analytic.

layer.description: Input layer. Null selects layers/counts for pearson_analytic and nb_glm_residual, and layers/log1p_norm for ols_log.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without computing the residuals.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

theta.description: Shared overdispersion in the Pearson denominator, as in scanpy normalize_pearson_residuals.

clip.description: Residual clip; null means sqrt(n_cells), the scanpy default.
Residual clip; null means sqrt(n_cells/30), the SCTransform clip.range default.

batch_genes.description: GPU genes per batch (integer or 'all'); null uses 100 above 100000 cells, else 'all'. Affects memory only.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: residuals written inline; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. layers/residual. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed calls: method, covariates, protect, clip, clipped_fraction, condition_number_ZtZ, n_genes. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
